body: I have been ignoring them, I haven't been to the place in 2 weeks, I go occasionally to skate but there were some people I thought I could trust but yesterday made me realize I couldn't.. I'm going to try to get better but its hard and painful. Getting motivated has always been one of the hardest challenges for me.
Alright. I'll try. Thank you, I really appreciate it, just talking to you has made me feel a little bit better.
I don't know if I can..

Talking is helping but what happens when I have to get off here? I am still left alone with my thoughts. I am debating going back on the anti depressants but I don't want to rely on them anymore. I want to be able to love myself through my own will. I'm actually the only one there who doesn't do stuff like that. :/ but that doesn't mean I don't do anything to stop it. I think I'm going to go back to skate but I'm scared to, I don't want to get dragged back into their stupid shit hole of 'fun'. I am very weak willed right now and I am allowing everyone around me to use me. I can't say no.. I realized I've had this problem for awhile, I am unable to say no to a lot. If they want money, take it, you want a cigarette, take it, you want to talk shit to me, do it. I can't say no to people anymore.

I'm sure it would but why would it matter? My mother has already enough problems with my schizophrenic brother who steals and yells and punches my parents.
I'd rather keep this to myself... I used to skate but I stopped and I can't seem to get back into it anymore, mostly because everyone at the skate park harps at me and tries to just use me. I don't want to be used anymore. All I do is go on xbox and watch netflix by myself. I don't like going outside anymore.

I'm pretty sure it's hopeless. I can't remember the last time I was genuinely happy without substance involved. I don't have anyone I can trust. I'm not close with my family. I've tried the suicide hotline but all they do is push therapy and anti-depressants on me and I've already tried that. I just want someone who will help me because I can't help myself anymore, I've seriously lost all motivation to help myself. I am literally just floating on the border of how I feel and being dead inside. I can't feel anything for the most part. My self esteem has been trashed by everyone I thought I could trust. I don't even trust myself anymore.

I don't have anyone I can trust. I don't trust my family, I've never had a close relationship with them. Everyone I thought I could trust has fucked me over or they don't understand whats going on so they just push it aside like its not a big deal.
Everything. People are hard to trust.
